title: Electricity Supply Industry Concession Order 2016
why: The annual electricity concession, the life support concession and the medical heating/cooling concession: eligibility (largely by Commonwealth concession cards) and the daily amounts. Made under s 43D of the Electricity Supply Industry Act 1995.
